title: EventBus mixed callback exception order contract

contract.delivery_order: Callbacks are delivered in listener registry order
contract.exception_isolation: An exception raised by one callback does not abort EventBus.emit()
contract.delivery_continuation: Callbacks registered after an exception-raising callback still receive the event
contract.emit_success: EventBus.emit() remains successful despite callback exceptions
contract.registry_stability: Callback exceptions do not corrupt or mutate the listener registry
contract.repeatability: Subsequent emits preserve the same callback delivery behavior
contract.callback_activation: All registered callbacks remain active after an isolated callback exception
contract.permission_enforcement: EventBus event delivery requires the events permission
